name: XCC_RECALC_PROCESS_ERRORS
description: This table contains all the errors encountered during recalculation.

columns.name: PROCESS_ERROR_ID
columns.description: Unique key to identify each record.

columns.name: RECALC_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Request identifier for the Prepare Control Budget Definition (PCBD) or Tree copy (TC).

columns.name: HEADER_ID
columns.description: Budgetary control transaction identifier.

columns.name: HEADER_NUM
columns.description: Unique identifier for a transaction or budget distribution.

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Line number to uniquely identify the transaction line within the transaction.

columns.name: SUMMARY_CONTROL_BUDGET_ID
columns.description: Control budget for which this transaction line is applicable.

columns.name: SUMMARY_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period in which funds must be consumed.

columns.name: MASTER_CONTROL_BUDGET_ID
columns.description: Unqiue identifier for the master control budget.

columns.name: MASTER_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period name for the master control budget.

columns.name: BUDGET_CCID
columns.description: Identifier for the new budget account.

columns.name: OLD_BUDGET_CCID
columns.description: Identifier for the previous budget account.

columns.name: CONCATENATED_SEGMENTS
columns.description: Concatenated value of the segments in the budget account.

columns.name: ERROR_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the type of error. Valid values are Warning and Error.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Error or warning message for the recalculation process.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
